alcohol.answer: Royal Jordanian's baggage restrictions page lists alcoholic beverages among the items it limits, without giving a quantity on the part we read. The same page sets its own drink rules: one 5-litre bottle of Zamzam water per eligible Umrah passenger, and olive oil only in a welded-cap container inside a wooden box.

sections.h: 🥃 What Royal Jordanian says about alcohol
sections.p: From the Royal Jordanian "Baggage restrictions" page, read on 22 November 2026.

head: Question
Royal Jordanian rule
rows: Named in the list of restricted items; no quantity or strength read
Perfumes, colognes, aerosols and medicines containing alcohol
Allowed in cabin or checked bags within quantity limits
One 5 L bottle per eligible Umrah passenger, free of charge, on MED, JED, RUH and DMM stations
Welded-cap container in a sturdy wooden box

list: Not on the page we read: the alcohol limit per person and whether it may go in the cabin. Ask Royal Jordanian before you fly with a bottle.

faq: Can I take alcohol on Royal Jordanian?
The airline lists alcoholic beverages as restricted but we could not read a quantity; confirm with Royal Jordanian.
Can I carry Zamzam water on Royal Jordanian?
One 5-litre bottle per eligible Umrah passenger is allowed free of charge on flights from Madinah, Jeddah, Riyadh and Dammam.
